text.text_excerpt: Paradigm gardens is one of our very favorite places to go. Every event that we have gone to here feels very special. The setting is unique and beautiful, and adds to the feel of the evening. The food that has always been served is some of the best I've had. The fun thing is that it is always different, with rotating chefs, and the foods they serve aren't necessarily food I would normally choose at a restaurant but I really enjoy them and it makes me try new things. There is always plenty of food too and I leave absolutely stuffed. The goat families are a bonus too, the babies are so cute I could go there just to watch them. They also do private events here, which I will definitely look in...

Came across this amazing weekly event at the Paradigm Gardens this past Sunday. I had such an amazing time and can not wait for what next week brings!! As you walk into the beautiful garden your engulfed with the sounds of music and the smell of fresh flowers blooming and herbs being sold. My crawfish and spinach and cheese empanadas from Empanola were so delicious! My taste buds were yelling for more. I also tried a Mexican chocolate paleta from Bayouside Paletas, which was delightfully refreshing with its rich chocolate bites inside. My hibiscus lemonade is a new favorite and I love how it was within a mason jar. Very eco friendly and who doesn't love cups !! lol Oh I can not forget the...

Friends and I came to Paradigm for their Sunday Farmer's Market and we absolutely loved it! It's within an actual garden, a small/quaint space with picnic benches, and delicious bites and drinks from local small businesses. The goats are such a nice treat to see, they're extremely gentle and they let you feed them. Our next plan is to attend one of their evening concerts with wine. Such a natural, cozy, gem in the heart of an urban city.
